rows.source_location: Results, Outcome measure 1 (PRIMARY), Excimer Light Treatment group
rows.access_level: registry record with posted results, read in full via API v2 (2026-11-27)
rows.design: randomized split-body (leg allocated), single-masked (outcomes assessor), pilot; untreated opposite leg as internal control
rows.skin_tone: not reported (Fitzpatrick types not given; race 5 White, 1 Black or African American)
rows.lesions_enrolled: 5 marked per leg (protocol plan); total not reported
rows.analysis_unit: patient as posted (denominator 6 participants per group); how the marked lesions were combined per patient is not reported
rows.intervention: XTRAC excimer laser 308 nm, twice weekly for 12 weeks, standard vitiligo protocol
rows.comparator: untreated marked lesions on the opposite leg
rows.endpoint_definition: blinded observer improvement from baseline on photographs, posted scale -1 worsening, 0 no improvement, 1 mild (<50%), 2 moderate, 3 full re-pigmentation on >75% IGH; mean per group
rows.assessment_method: photographic comparison by blinded observer (protocol: two blinded dermatologists)
rows.time_from_last_treatment: [about 0: final photographs and surveys at the 25th visit, which had no treatment; interval after the last treatment not stated]
rows.arm_result: mean 2.31 (95% CI 2.08 to 2.54) on the posted -1 to 3 scale, i.e. between moderate and full re-pigmentation on >75% IGH
rows.patient_noticeability: not measured in this endpoint (subject self-assessment posted as a separate endpoint)
rows.complete_match: not reported (mean scale score only; no count of lesions with a complete match)
rows.dark_overshoot: not reported (scale has no darkening-beyond-surround category; no adverse events posted)
rows.texture_or_scar: no adverse events posted (other adverse events 0 of 6 in each group)
rows.uncertainty: Posted scale (-1 to 3) differs from the protocol scale (1 to 5, same five categories shifted by 2); values read on the posted scale. Groups are described as lesions but the denominator is 6 participants; non-integer means with narrow 95% CI suggest lesion-level averaging, so the true n and any clustering adjustment are unknown. No statistical comparison with control is posted. Same cohort as gordon2017 (journal article, paywalled): reconcile before merge so the six patients are not counted twice. Only assessment is at the end of the 12-week course; registry lists 'lack of extended follow-up' as a limitation, so nothing here bears on a six-month match. Planned 10 subjects, 6 enrolled, all female. Protocol says grades every 4 weeks (weeks 4, 8, 12) but only one time point is posted. Gap between the last treatment and the final (25th, no-treatment) visit is not stated; months_after_final_tx 0 is inferred.
